chunks.text: Check the condition, return window, gift status, and transport restrictions separately. A lantern that contains a lithium battery still follows the battery shipping rules. The recipient of an eligible gift return receives store credit under the gift policy; allocation does not change that credit into a bank-card refund. Original shipping fees and a purchased return label remain separate from these item amounts.

This article does not supply a temperature specification for every model, a chemical treatment recipe, or a prediction of remaining battery life. Refer product-specific questions to the relevant manual or product team when the required detail is absent.

Drying and storing outdoor equipment  Dry tents completely before putting them into long-term storage. Moisture trapped in folded fabric can cause mold, odors, and damage to coatings. Brush off loose dirt gently and follow the product's cleaning instructions. Do not use a washing machine or household bleach on a tent. A storage problem is not automatically a manufacturing defect.  Keep sleeping bags dry and store them loosely when space allows. Long-term compression can reduce loft. The product label controls the permitted washing method; different insulation and fabrics may need different treatment. A support agent should not infer washing-machine compatibility merely from the generic sleeping-bag category.  Rechargeable equipment should follow its manufacturer's charging and storage instructions. If a battery is swollen, leaking, or damaged, use the battery-safety process. Generic care advice does not authorize continued charging. This article does not supply a temperature specification for every model, a chemical treatment recipe, or a prediction of remaining battery life.

Delivery restrictions for rechargeable products  Products containing lithium batteries travel by ground service within the contiguous United States. The rule covers rechargeable lanterns, headlamps, power banks, and navigation devices, including products whose batteries are installed inside the equipment. These products cannot be sent by our air services, to Alaska or Hawaii, or to an international destination.  Selecting express shipping at checkout does not override this restriction. If a mixed order includes an ordinary item and a rechargeable device, the rechargeable item still travels by ground. A support agent must not promise that paying the express surcharge makes a battery shipment eligible for air transport. The customer can remove the battery product and place a separate order for the other items if those items qualify for the requested service.  Ground shipping has the delivery estimate shown at checkout for the destination. This policy does not supply a guaranteed arrival date for a particular parcel. Tracking events come from the carrier after dispatch.

Tent manufacturing warranty  Tents have a 24-month warranty for manufacturing defects, beginning on the purchase date. A stitching seam that separates during normal use can qualify. The customer must provide proof of purchase and clear photos so the repair team can assess the failure. The warranty team chooses repair or replacement after assessment; support cannot promise a cash refund before that decision.  Damage from animals, sharp objects, storms beyond the tent's rating, ordinary fabric wear, or incorrect storage is outside this warranty. Accidental damage can still be sent for a paid repair assessment. A quotation must be approved before paid repair work starts. The repair-price guide lists the fixed fees that are currently published; some repairs require an individual quote.  Customers should dry a tent before packing it for inspection. Do not include fuel canisters, batteries, food, or personal belongings. An approved manufacturing-defect claim receives a prepaid ground label.

Refund allocation for discounted bundles  When a bundle has one discounted purchase price, allocate that price across its items in proportion to their individual prices at the time of purchase. Refunding one eligible item returns that allocated paid amount. It does not return the item's current price or its undiscounted original price. Retaining other items does not by itself cancel the allocation.  The camping starter kit contains a lantern listed at USD 30, a stove listed at USD 50, and a carry case listed at USD 20. Their individual prices total USD 100. When the customer paid USD 80 for the kit, the allocated paid amounts are USD 24 for the lantern, USD 40 for the stove, and USD 16 for the case. These amounts total the USD 80 actually paid.  The allocation determines money, not return eligibility. Check the condition, return window, gift status, and transport restrictions separately.

Check the lithium-delivery and oversize-delivery articles before promising this service. A customer cannot pay a surcharge to remove a product restriction. The membership benefit covers qualifying standard delivery only. It does not discount the USD 18 express price or change the cutoff time.

Items containing an undamaged lithium battery must use the eligible ground service. A damaged, swollen, or leaking battery must never be sent using this ordinary label; use the damaged-battery procedure. Label creation does not count as dispatch. The parcel must actually be handed to the carrier within the return's dispatch deadline.

Express order processing  Express delivery for eligible ordinary parcels costs USD 18. It has a two-business-day transit target after dispatch. Orders accepted before 13:00 Eastern Time on a business day are dispatched that day. Orders accepted at or after 13:00, or on a weekend, are dispatched on the next business day. Business days for this policy are Monday through Friday excluding published holidays.  The transit clock starts after dispatch, not when the customer adds an item to the basket. For an eligible order placed on a Monday at 14:00 during a week with no holidays, dispatch is Tuesday and the two-business-day transit target is Thursday. Payment review or an address problem can prevent dispatch until the issue is resolved. Do not infer that a particular order cleared those checks from this policy alone.  Some product categories cannot use express delivery. Check the lithium-delivery and oversize-delivery articles before promising this service.
